question: ________ ​refers to the cessation of menstruation.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Menopause.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Menopause marks the permanent cessation of menstrual cycles, typically occurring between the ages of **45-55**, signaling the end of a woman's reproductive phase.
 
• It is caused by a decline in the production of hormones such as **estrogen** and** progesterone** by the ovaries, leading to various physiological changes.
 
• Common symptoms include hot flashes, night sweats, mood swings, and changes in sleep patterns, often requiring **medical attention.**
 
• **Post-menopausal Health Risks: **Women are at increased risk of **osteoporosis** and **cardiovascular** diseases after menopause due to reduced **estrogen** levels, making post-menopausal care essential.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Menses:**

 
 
• Menses refers to the regular monthly shedding of the uterine lining, known as** menstruation**, in women of reproductive age.
 
• It is part of the menstrual cycle, typically lasting 28 days, with menses marking the beginning of each cycle (days 1–5).
 
 
 
• **Menarche:**
 
 
• Menarche is the term for the **first** occurrence of menstruation, signaling the onset o**f puberty** in girls, usually between the ages of **11-14**.
 
• It marks the beginning of a female's reproductive capability and is an important biological and social milestone.
 
 
 
• **Hypermenorrhea:**
 
 
• Hypermenorrhea refers to abnormally heavy or prolonged **menstrual bleeding,** often exceeding 7 days.
 
• It can be caused by** hormonal imbalances**, uterine fibroids, or other medical conditions and may require medical evaluation and treatment.
